description: Lists a collection's items, drafts included, with search, status and field filters, sorting, and paging. Use it to check what's already in a collection before importing, or to find items. Up to 100 items per call; page with offset.

operator.description: eq (default) matches any of comma-separated values, e.g. "eq".

offset.description: Items to skip, e.g. 50 for the second page of 50.

q.description: Search titles and text fields, e.g. "pizza".

sort.description: position (default), createdAt, updatedAt, publishedAt, title, or a field key; prefix - for descending, e.g. "-updatedAt".

status.description: Only drafts or only published items, e.g. "published".

trashed.description: List trashed items instead, e.g. true.

name: list_collection_items
title: List collection items
